questions.question: Match List-I with List-II: List-I List-II A. Ovum I. 8-16 celled embryo formed in fallopian tube B. Zygote II. Implantation occurs in the uterine endometrium C. Morula III. Formed after sperm entry D. Blastocyst IV. Single, diploid cell formed as a result of fertilization

questions.question: Blastocyst becomes embedded in the ______ of the uterus. This is called______ and it leads to pregnancy.

Given below are two statements. Statement-I: After implantation, blastocyst gets embedded in the myometrium of uterus. Statement-II: Uterine cells divide rapidly and cover the blastocyst once it gets attached to the uterine wall. In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options: Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect.
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct.
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct.
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are incorrect.
questions.explanation: Option (B) is correct: Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct..
